summary: Marksmanship with a cat instead of Lone Wolf. The pet does about 9% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) at -1.5s, recast in its last 3s. The raid's mark is off
Serpent Sting when it's down, first
Arcane Shot on cooldown, before Aimed Shot, at any mana
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot, at any mana
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana is at least 10 per second of fight left

Melee weave between Auto Shots. Walk in for a main-hand swing with Raptor Strike queued, when the next Auto Shot is 1.2s or less away and no shot comes off cooldown. Only while mana is at least 25 per second of fight left
The cat (1.0s) bites and claws on its own. Auto Shot the whole fight
caveats: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power, from the launch realms' hotfix of 2026-11-03 (ranks 20, 35, 50, 75 and 100). Hunter's Mark gives 143 after a server hotfix (older clients said 71).
Uses Aspect of the Hawk rank 6 (110 ranged attack power), from the launch realms' hotfix of 2026-11-03 (the client still says 55).
The pet gets 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power on top of its own 254, plus the hunter's crit and hit (from beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot gets 15% of ranged attack power, and Serpent Sting 5% a tick, from Blizzard's November 2 notes. No game data has them.
Auto Shot keeps firing during casts. Moving cancels its 0.5s wind-up.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add 13 DPS.
Holds back Sniper Shot and the melee weave to save mana. It does 1217.6 DPS at 300s.
Crit per Agility is Classic's level 60 rate (0.0189% per point), from Forever's game files.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as seen on a level 17 pet. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2 DPS (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.

Ranged slot is the Phase 0 list's pick, Hyper Deluxe Sniper Rifle Mk XVII (a 2.5s gun). Forever's Auto Shot and hunter shots need a bow, gun or crossbow, so the list has no thrown weapons. The old 2.5s bow against 2.6s gun comparison was for the synthetic gear.
Assumed: each hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs 0 to 2.9 DPS at 180s (2.6 here).
No Scorpid Sting. Balance druids already keep up Insect Swarm, which gives the same 2% hit reduction. Scorpid Sting would replace Serpent Sting and cost about 85 to 100 DPS for nothing.

Improved Tracking 5/5 counts against the generic boss, unlike creature-type talents such as Beast Slaying: a hunter can track every raid boss type except Mechanical. It is worth 52.8 DPS (4.2%) here, which this build loses against a Mechanical boss.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_mm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark (standards 23, Mark duty assumed), so the raid's debuffs.huntersMark is off. Orc since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. No Goblin Sapper since 2026-11-02 (consumables-20261101-1): it reaches only 10 yd and the hunter stands at 12 or 25 yd, so it went off only when a weave happened to be under way at its cooldown, for 0.0 to 0.5 at 180 sec; the Dense Dynamite stays.
